input: A customer asks: 'I bought an extended 2-year warranty on my laptop. It's been 16 months and the screen just died. Am I covered?' The store's warranty policy: standard 1-year warranty covers manufacturing defects; an extended 2-year warranty (sold separately) extends the same defect-coverage by one additional year past the standard warranty (total coverage window: 2 years from purchase). Screen failure of this kind is a covered manufacturing defect. The customer purchased the extended warranty at the time of laptop purchase. Answer the customer's eligibility question concisely.
